adjudication.rationale: The finding claims that editing a group name before adding/removing members causes issues because it 'mutates by the original ID but reloads by the unsaved name'. Looking at the diff, the addMembers and removeMember functions use this.get('id') for the API call and then call findMembers() which uses this.get('name'). However, the group name is only editable for non-automatic groups during creation (before an ID exists), and once a group has an ID, the name field is bound to the model. The findMembers function at line 25 checks if name is empty and returns early. The scenario described - editing a name before adding members - doesn't match the actual code flow. When adding members via the admin UI, the group already has an ID and name from the server. The name change would need to be saved first before it affects anything. This is a speculative edge case not clearly demonstrated by the diff.
